purpose: Correct the V84B1 pooled-voxel pseudoreplication before any V84C training: count each global physical target cell once in total, estimate tail curvature with equal realization/spatial-block weighting, and prospectively sequester a cell-disjoint outer development set.

amendment.reason: Correct the CAMELS provenance object count, which initialized at the domain inner count and then added each realization count a second time. Voxel occurrences, unique-cell weights, tail statistics, and the scientific decision were unaffected.

audit_scope.allowed_payload: only the prospectively selected inner subset of the immutable V35 train target and train cache payloads
audit_scope.physical_cell_weight: for each simulation realization, every global target cell has total weight one across overlapping observer-cube occurrences
audit_scope.conditional_context_handling: if one physical cell appears under multiple observer conditions, retain all residual contexts with inverse occurrence multiplicity so their total cell weight is one
audit_scope.CAMELS_uncertainty_unit: one realization with equal unit weight
audit_scope.TNG100_uncertainty_unit: one nonoverlapping 60^3-cell global spatial block with equal unit weight after frozen coverage requirements
audit_scope.tail_shape_null: a single exponential excess has the same scale from tail survival 1 to 0.2 as from 0.2 to 0.02

prospective_outer_development.qualification: sequestered from V84C0 onward but not statistically independent because all source train simulations informed earlier model generations

TNG100.selection: within the former V84B fit indices, seed 840384 global-grid anchor and 32 nearest cube centers; remove from inner every observer cube sharing even one target cell with the outer union

go_no_go.domain_decreasing_far_slope_evidence: median far/near scale below 0.85, at least 70 percent of equal-weight units below one, and equal-unit bootstrap mean 90 percent upper endpoint below one
go_no_go.domain_increasing_far_slope_evidence: median far/near scale above 1.15, at least 70 percent of equal-weight units above one, and equal-unit bootstrap mean 90 percent lower endpoint above one
go_no_go.upper_two_slope_V84C_go: decreasing evidence in at least two domains and median ratio below 1.05 in the third
go_no_go.lower_tail_change_go: the same increasing or decreasing evidence direction in all three domains
go_no_go.if_go: compare exactly one finite-physical-moment upper two-slope tempered exponential candidate against the unchanged V84B exponential control under nested group/block CV
go_no_go.if_no_go: stop marginal tail expansion and return resources to CF4 low-k constraints plus LCDM high-k sampling and forward halo/void selection

gate_redesign_frozen_before_audit.primary: equal-group/block weighted NLL and 1e-3 tail calibration with group/block uncertainty
gate_redesign_frozen_before_audit.secondary: 1e-4 point estimate and group/block uncertainty interval
